Wood-Fired Heating

Two ways to fire it

Every tub comes with a 30kW stainless steel wood burner as standard. Choose the loading style that suits your setup.

Internally Loaded

The stove sits inside the tub, with a raised seat section above it, keeping everything compact and self-contained. Wood is loaded from inside the tub area, making it a neat all-in-one unit. Ideal where space around the tub is limited.

Externally Loaded

The stove firebox sits outside the tub, so you load and tend the fire from outside while you soak. No raised seat needed, the full interior is yours. Great if you want maximum bathing space and prefer to manage the fire without getting out.

Both options use the same 30kW stainless steel burner. AISI 304 (standard) or AISI 316 (marine grade upgrade) available.
Smart Electric Control

Your tub, at the touch of a button

Upgrade to our Smart Electric system and take full control of your hot tub, from your phone, or at the touch of a button.

Touch Screen Panel

Intuitive full-colour controller on the tub. Set temperature, manage jets and lighting in one place.

WiFi and App Control

Pre-heat before you arrive, check the temperature from the sofa.

3kW Electric Heater

Holds your set temperature automatically. No fire-lighting, just set it and forget it.

Unlocks Advanced Features

Required for powered jet pumps, UV sterilisation and micro-silk water care. Hybrid compatible with a wood burner.

Smart Electric upgrade £650. Hybrid (wood plus electric) £1,100.

Circle and Square Hot Tubs

Colour Changing LED Lighting

Set the mood with underwater colour-changing LED lights, a simple but stunning addition to your hot tub experience.

Wood-fired tubs: a simple push-button on the side, cycle through colours with no electrical system needed.

Electric and hybrid tubs: fully integrated into the Balboa panel, adjust colour, brightness and modes from the touchscreen or app.

Choose a single large LED, or a constellation of 10 small star lights for a truly magical atmosphere.
